claims: Production first fixes source/index/HEAD identity, predecessor public-receipt hash and original capture identity, then privately reads and verifies the whole captured workbook bytes.

On the same in-memory bytes, inherited categorical classification must match LOCAL_EXTRA_PRESENT at entry_local with CHECKED same-entry checks, only one primary category, no supplementary categories, and successful archive close.

The locator scans bounded local headers from offset zero, checks every skipped local/name/extra/compressed span, and selects the first positive local-extra region; it introduces no second ZipFile or name decoding.

The field walker reads only consecutive four-byte little-endian uint16 ID/length headers, checks data-span bounds and advances over opaque data. It permits unknown/duplicate IDs and zero-length data, caps at 256 records and at a 65535-byte local-extra region, and publishes either the completed ordered list or null.

LOCAL_EXTRA_HEADERS_COMPLETE establishes completion of this first local-extra structural walk only. It neither accepts the entire archive nor identifies field payload semantics or worksheet/scientific schema.

Inherited ZipFile use decodes directory names and metadata and may process ordinary central extras. The local_extra_payload_interpreted=false flag is narrower than a claim of no raw payload exposure or no ZIP metadata interpretation.
All expected diagnoses remain BLOCKED_SCHEMA with unknown scientific counts, zero fits/splits, no member decompression or XML/worksheet decoding. Two matching runs would be computational replay only.
